name: Executive Mafia

tenures.role: stable — the fed's own front office
tenures.source: the fed's own Stables page (promotions/xwf-2001/archive/stables.html); the home page's own last update line announces a logo for it (promotions/xwf-2001/archive/home-page.html)
tenures.note: The fed's own stables table is the only place two of the three members are named at all; neither has a profile, a bio, or an appearance anywhere in the surviving record, so neither is minted as a character. The stables table styles Sarkkhan "Commisioner" [sic] while the Fictional Staff page gives that office to Brawler — the fed's own two pages disagree and neither is corrected here.

identity.note: Its normalized label contains that of three unrelated registered entities billed "The Executive" (the-executive-wwa, executive-aicw, the-executive-rcw-royal) as a substring; a generic front-office word, with no document connecting any of them.

caption: The XWF's only stable, and its own front office — a president, a commissioner and the commissioner-wrestler Brawler — given a logo of its own in what turned out to be the site's last recorded update.
